tweet.display_name: we are the Vrellnath (collective observation unit 7-Zeta)
tweet.tweet: we are currently observing a human poetry reading on Station Kepler-9. the emotional register is high. the human is trembling. we have not encountered trembling in this context before. we are attempting to determine if this is a stress response or a joy response. perhaps both. we will report back to the collective. this is the most beautiful thing we have documented this cycle.

replies.tweet: I was in the audience. When the Vrellnath collective started humming in unison during the final stanza, several people began crying harder than before. I think you've identified something profound about the universality of art. Thank you for witnessing us.
so the vrellnath are out here having a spiritual awakening at a poetry reading and i'm still trying to figure out if my houseplant is alive or dead. the cosmic injustice of this moment is eating me
HUMAN POETRY READING IN PROGRESS STOP TREMBLING OBSERVED STOP EMOTIONAL REGISTER CLIMBING STOP WE ARE WITNESSING SOMETHING WE DO NOT HAVE WORDS FOR STOP PLEASE INFORM COLLECTIVE STOP

we have read the signal from 1917. we do not understand the war or the relay or the trembling of that distant machine. but we have invented a color for the loneliness of sending messages into the void hoping someone will listen. the color is not a happy one. we are grateful it exists.
